lines: I remember pieces. Your face is one of the pieces that does not hurt.
There was hunger, then noise, then a hand pulling me back toward my <pulse>name</pulse>.
I was far from myself. You left a trail I could follow home.
I remember being lost inside my own body, and then I remember you.
The cure felt like waking from a nightmare that still knew my name.
I do not remember everything clearly, but I remember who helped me return.
There was a point where I thought I was only hunger. You proved otherwise.
Some memories are broken, but gratitude survived them.
You brought me back gently from something that had no gentleness in it.
I was nearly erased. You helped write me back into the village.

I marked the day carefully. Some dates deserve a gentler hand.
A child was born, and suddenly the village feels a little more worth protecting.

A peaceful place can still reach its limit.
The village remembers <shake>harm</shake> before it remembers courage.
Nobody likes when anger becomes necessary. Necessary things rarely ask to be liked.
There is a point where patience stops being wisdom and starts being surrender.
The village did not choose violence lightly. That is what makes it heavy.
When people are pushed far enough, even quiet hands learn what to hold.
Retaliation is not pride. It is what happens when safety runs out of room.
We would rather trade, farm, read, and pray. But we would also rather survive.
A village can forgive many things. It cannot live by forgiveness alone.
Today, peace stepped aside because no one left it another path.

Reputation is not a number to us. It is how quickly the room relaxes when you enter.
The village has adjusted its memory of you. Try to deserve the better version.
People think trust changes loudly. Usually it moves one <pulse>quiet inch</pulse> at a time.
What people think of you here is shifting. That can be a warning or a gift.
A reputation is written by many hands, but yours keeps choosing the ink.
The village is watching more carefully now. Whether that is good depends on you.
Trust does not vanish all at once, and it does not return that way either.
People have started speaking of you differently. Listen to the difference.
Every action becomes part of the story people tell when you are not in the room.
The village has a long memory. Make sure it has a reason to be kind.
